reached_sql:
SELECT 
    cs.cs_item_sk AS i_item_id,
    ca.ca_country,
    ca.ca_state,
    ca.ca_county,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4,
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5,
    AVG(CAST(c.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6,
    AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7
FROM 
    catalog_sales cs
JOIN 
    customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
JOIN 
    customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN 
    date_dim dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
JOIN 
    item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN 
    customer_demographics cd1 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
JOIN 
    customer_demographics cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
WHERE 
    cd1.cd_gender = 'F' AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    AND c.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4)
    AND dd.d_year = 2001
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA')
GROUP BY 
    ROLLUP (cs.cs_item_sk, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county)
ORDER BY 
    ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county, cs.cs_item_sk
LIMIT 100
